goal: Prevent command and argument injection via malformed Tor control daemon replies and cached keys
Protect node operators from hijacked inbound onion traffic and Tor shutdowns caused by invalid keys
agreement: Strong support with all reviewer concerns addressed
Substantive support for strictly validating daemon replies and cached keys (vasild, jeanpablojp)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD 15 (winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents Tor control command and argument injection from malformed daemon replies
Protects node operators against inbound onion traffic hijacking and unexpected Tor daemon shutdowns
Exploitation is constrained because it requires a compromised or impersonated Tor control endpoint
